task_language_draft: Use this marker to write the letter L on the whiteboard.

scene_assets.expected_result_evidence: post-rollout rendered black ink trail from reviewed marker-tip contact samples on the public whiteboard_front image

tool_assets.trajectory_policy: No pre-authored letter trajectory is a method input; VLM scene refs define start, optional path_points, and explicit end from public side-board evidence.

vlm_scene_refs_same_prompt_pending_revie.prompt_policy: The shared task-generic VLM scene-ref interface applies: natural task language and public RGB-D evidence provide start_point, optional path_points, explicit end_point, and scene.direction when applicable. These refs define task intent, not a robot trajectory.

start_point.description: VLM-marked path start point on the visible blank whiteboard surface.

path_points.description: One or more VLM-marked intermediate whiteboard scene refs, using the same point-marking convention as existing scene refs.

end_point.description: VLM-marked path end point on the visible blank whiteboard surface.

target_surface_normal.description: Whiteboard surface normal recorded for contact projection and diagnostics; it is not a default motion or approach direction.

compiler_constraints_draft.constraint_type: marker-tip ordered VLM scene-ref path following with whole-tool SE(3) subgoals
compiler_constraints_draft.waypoint_policy: Lift the VLM-marked start_point, path_points, and end_point pixels through public RGB-D to the whiteboard surface, then compile marker-tip contact subgoals in that order.

initialization_policy_pending_review.description: At reset, the marker body and reviewed tip start outside the whiteboard footprint with a visible gap. The approach path may later bring the reviewed tip into whiteboard contact.
initialization_policy_pending_review.preview_status: seed 000 shifted off the blank side whiteboard for whiteboard_front review

ink_evidence_policy_pending_review.policy: Ink evidence is generated from the reviewed tool.contact_point marker tip / writing end. Tool center, gripper, handle, cap, shaft, and whole-tool pose trajectories are excluded from ink generation.

contact_gate.source_point: tool.contact_point xyz_tool transformed by rollout actual_pose_xyzw, or matching rollout contact-point sample from tracking_samples

thresholds_tolerances.vlm_judge_success_rule: VLM judge evaluates the produced marker-tip ink evidence; no path/OCR/template score is a success gate

allowed_method_inputs: public RGB-D blank side-whiteboard scene evidence
task-generic VLM scene refs from the existing brush/eraser-style prompt
VLM-marked public start/path/end scene refs on the whiteboard
whole-tool SE(3) subgoals compiled from lifted scene refs
forbidden_method_inputs: pre-rendered target trace or guide path on the whiteboard
direct robot or joint trajectory from VLM

notes: This is the current provisional hard marker side-board task for writing L.
Success is VLM-judged from produced marker-tip ink evidence.
The VLM judge is the automatic semantic success gate for this task.
Visible ink is rendered only from measured marker-tip contact samples on the whiteboard surface.
Human accepted this as a difficult benchmark candidate; low current success is expected and should be reported rather than repaired with seed-specific shortcuts.

semantic_target.success_scope: VLM-judged legibility of produced marker-tip ink; automatic rollout/contact metrics are diagnostic only

vlm_judge_evaluation.rule: The produced marker-tip ink should be visually recognizable as the requested piecewise-linear path letter L on the whiteboard, without severe off-surface artifacts or non-tip ink artifacts.
